title: Tenant RBAC seed automation and idempotent policy-bundle publish for Private installer (terraform + helm)
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: make tenant bootstrap for Private deployments fully automated and idempotent so on-prem/VPC installs can reliably seed tenant roles and publish a policy-bundle without manual k8s steps. This PR introduces a Terraform module to generate tenant-scoped RBAC manifests, a small CLI hook inside the private-installer to apply a validated policy bundle (via Helm/ConfigMap) and additions to the charts so the policy-bundle operator can reconcile published bundles. Key changes: 1) terraform/modules/rbac: new tenant_seed.tf and variables to render scoped RoleBindings, Namespaces, and a signing key reference; 2) helm/values/private: added policyBundle.publish.enabled flag and templated ConfigMap output; 3) cmd/private-installer: rbac_seed.go implements a dry-run 3-step flow: terraform plan->render->apply/helm publish; 4) charts/policy-bundle: small template to watch for published bundle ConfigMaps and reconcile; 5) docs/private/rbac-automation.md: end-to-end usage and troubleshooting; 6) tests/e2e/tenant_bootstrap_test.go: local cluster e2e covering idempotency and rollback. Checklist: [x] Terraform module with examples [x] Installer hook and CLI flag --seed-rbac [x] Helm templating for policy bundle publish [x] e2e tests and CI pipeline job [x] Docs and release note draft Backwards compatibility: default behavior is off; operator will only reconcile bundles with label redwood.com/source=installer so existing clusters are unaffected. Rollback path: installer supports --dry-run and --revert-on-fail and will remove created RoleBindings on failure; Helm release is created with a unique name per-tenant to allow chart rollback. Related: Linear ENG-2081 and ENG-2103, support ticket SUP-112. This description is one line to preserve PR export formatting.

release_notes: Add terraform module and installer automation to seed tenant RBAC and publish policy bundles for Private deployments. Disabled by default; opt-in via installer flag --seed-rbac. Includes helm templating, e2e tests, and docs.
notes_on_rollbacks: Installer supports --revert-on-fail to undo created RoleBindings and Helm releases are tenant-scoped so standard helm rollback/release-delete works. If a partial terraform apply occurs use provided terraform state snapshot in artifacts to run 'terraform destroy' for the generated resources.
security_considerations: Signing key is referenced, not embedded. Module expects a KMS/HSM key ARN or a sealed secret; installer will not log secret material. Audit events emitted to audit-log-exporter when policy bundle is published.
migration_instructions: Existing clusters unaffected. To enable automatic seeding for a tenant run the private-installer with --seed-rbac --tenant <name> and provide terraform variables or a TFVARS file. See docs/private/rbac-automation.md for examples.
